fact_text: Oil prices were far above normal levels around 31 Mar 2026 because of the Middle East conflict, and the analyst said only de-escalation solves the problem.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 31 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Surge | | Inflation & Energy Stocks Outlook | Stock Market' (YouTube, 2026-03-31)

fact_text: High oil reaches Pakistan's economy through import costs; the analyst saw a Gulf de-escalation as the key to lower oil and a better outlook for the KSE-100.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 31 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Surge | | Inflation & Energy Stocks Outlook | Stock Market' (YouTube, 2026-03-31)

fact_text: Richards Bay coal from South Africa, used by Pakistan's cement and power plants, rose from about $90 to $112 a tonne, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 31 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Surge | | Inflation & Energy Stocks Outlook | Stock Market' (YouTube, 2026-03-31)

fact_text: Richards Bay coal used by cement and power plants tracks oil and the dollar, so coal costs tend to rise when oil prices rise.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 31 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Surge | | Inflation & Energy Stocks Outlook | Stock Market' (YouTube, 2026-03-31)

fact_text: Higher oil and coal import prices feed imported cost-push inflation into Pakistan, which the analyst said removes the case for the interest rate cuts that were expected.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 31 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Surge | | Inflation & Energy Stocks Outlook | Stock Market' (YouTube, 2026-03-31)

fact_text: The KSE-100 fell partly because a possible policy rate increase was already priced into the index, according to the analyst.
